name: resource-guard-agent
description: Checks memory and runtime resource leak risks for agents, servers, browser automation, workers, caches, streams, and large-data tasks.

metadata.trigger: before closing work that touches long-running runtimes, background workers, browser automation, subprocesses, caches, streams, large-data processing, file handles, network connections, timers, or subscriptions
metadata.policy: If resource_risk_occurred=true in work-evaluator input, resource_check_targets must be present. Required resource risks must be mitigated with evidence, accepted with rationale, marked not_applicable with rationale, or treated as rework. Required lifecycle checks must show create/open/start and cleanup/close/stop paths. Required measurement checks must name the metric, tool, threshold, and evidence.
